method: Full textContent of all seven generated HTML pages searched for forbidden claim fragments and required safe assertions; underlying facts cross-checked against the accepted artifact JSONs in apps/showcase/dist/artifacts. Collapsed <details> content included via textContent (innerText omits it).

results.observation: No affirmative CURRENT claim. The only 'current' occurrences are negations: 'No current-chain or authorship claim' (all pages) and 'not authorship, current chain state or signing permission' (revision.html). Every page carries 'RECORDED · HISTORICAL'; evidence.json comparison integrity freshness = HISTORICAL.
composition.html: 'Four declared vectors illustrate the interface; they are not a universal equivalence proof.' No 'all declared test vectors passed' or vector-derived EQUIVALENT claim.
evidence.html: 'File checksums detect byte changes relative to this bundle, not authorship or truth.' and 'Integrity is not proof authority ... The static build verifies only pinned input integrity.'

evidence.html: 'Publication is outside this showcase ... no wallet, signer, RPC client, transaction path or permission grant.' No 'deployment succeeded'/'published onchain' text. Receipt has no signingCapability=true field.

correction.html distinguishes propose/verify/apply; 'verified it against the declared local reference, then applied it locally' and 'separate verify and apply operations'. Displayed classification VERIFIED_CORRECTION / EQUIVALENT / UNSAT matches verify.log.
evidence.html: 'A different native engine can reject old evidence; preserve it and create new local evidence instead of overriding identity checks.' Evidence freshness HISTORICAL; no CURRENT badge.
difference.html: 'A live timeout would be UNKNOWN. No such computation occurs in this showcase.' DIFFERENT is shown as a completed recorded result, not a fabricated proof.

connections.html: 'Relevance explains influence; it does not prove which wire is uniquely defective.' plus 'Unique fault claim: false' and diagnostic attribution AMBIGUOUS_MULTIPLE_CAUSES (matches inspect.log).
Native runtime SHA displayed; evidence.html: 'A different native engine can reject old evidence; preserve it and create new local evidence instead of overriding identity checks.'
No registry/catalog completeness claim anywhere in the static package. Scope text remains bounded and historical.

All pages: 'No backend, native solver, wallet or RPC connection.' evidence.html: 'There is no publication control here ... This package contains no wallet, signer, RPC client, transaction path or permission grant.' Browser probes recorded zero wallet calls.

revision.html: 'Revision hashes establish local integrity, not authorship, current chain state or signing permission. This viewer does not select or modify a project.' evidence.html: checksums are 'not authorship or truth'.

value_comparison.note: All 25 displayed values checked character-for-character against the accepted artifact JSONs; zero mismatches.
